Perfect — confirmed for Tue 3/23 15:00–15:30 PST. Calendar invite sent.

Quick answers and pre-read so the call is efficient:

PO process (summary)
- Redwood issues POs following procurement sign-off; standard net-30 unless otherwise negotiated.
- Proc owner: Marcus Lin (cc'd) will own PO issuance and vendor setup in the procurement portal.
- Invoices should reference the PO number and be sent to ap@redwoodinference.com; remit address is on the PO.

MAP (high-level milestones + owners)
- Intake questionnaire returned (owner: CloudApps / Samantha) — target: 3/24 EOD
- Vendor validation (insurance, W-9, legal review) — owner: Monica (Redwood) — target: 3/25
- PO issued & signed — owner: Marcus (Redwood) — target: 3/29
- Account activation & test run — owner: CloudApps ops — target: 4/1

Success criteria
- Signed PO in Redwood system and receipt of first invoice
- Successful first test call within activated account (smoke test)
- MAP sign-off by both parties

Attached: Redwood_PO_Template_v1.xlsx and redwood_vendor_checklist_2027.pdf — please complete the checklist and return any missing docs in advance of the call (W-9 already received, thanks).

Looking forward — agenda for the 30m will be: 1) intros (5m), 2) MAP review & timeline (10m), 3) PO & AP details (8m), 4) next steps & actions (7m).

Att: Redwood_PO_Template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_vendor_checklist_2027.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Neha
